objective: Prepare a public Hugging Face MCP Space for public GitHub repositories and a distributable CLI.

decisions: The user chose a public remote Space for public GitHub repositories only. Never expose arbitrary filesystem or existing local MCP operations. Each request must use isolated temporary data; validate repository identifiers, restrict outbound hosts and redirects, cap download and extraction resources, avoid running repository code, and prevent cross-request leakage. Follow Gradio MCP Space conventions, implement useful retrieval using existing LazyToken, and make the staged Space self-contained.

acceptance: Deliver Space source and staging procedure with meaningful isolated tests and report remaining security or hosting limits.

decisions: User authorized public CLI availability. Identify concrete packaging/publication blockers and upgrade compatibility, including existing uncommitted changes; do not publish or modify files.

acceptance: Report reproducible findings and exact release artifacts, commands and remaining risks.
